label: Rev 0 set
source: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024), pages 3-5; card values FCOM R17 LIM where a card exists, summary text otherwise (provenance sop)

groups.name: 100 ft AGL pair
groups.hook: Autopilot in and out of the ground: 100' after takeoff, 100' after a manual go-around.

groups.name: AP approach ladder 160 / 250 / 500
groups.hook: ILS without CAT 2 or 3 on the FMA 160', anything not ILS 250', every other phase 500'.

groups.name: Autoland box 35 / 10 / 15, CONF 3 or FULL
groups.hook: Head 35, tail 10, cross 15 (OpSpec 060). Only CONF 3 or FULL.

groups.name: Wind on the ground 32 / 15 / 45 / 10 and doors 40 (50) / 60
groups.hook: Takeoff 32 cross, 15 tail. Landing 45 cross, 10 tail (same 10 as autoland tailwind). Doors: operate to 40, 50 nose into wind, close by 60.

groups.name: 41,450 twins
groups.hook: The aircraft ceiling and the APU start/operate ceiling are the same number.

groups.name: Altitude ladder 25,000 / 22,500 / 20,000 / 17,500 / 12,500
groups.hook: APU battery start 25,000, one pack 22,500, bleed engine start 20,000 (same as FL200 flaps/slats), two packs 17,500, runway 12,500. Steps of 2,500 down to the two-pack line.

groups.name: 230 kt pair
groups.hook: Wipers and open cockpit window share 230 kt.

groups.name: VFE ladder 240 (215) / 196 (205) / 186 / 180
groups.hook: Flap 1 is 240 with 1+F at 215; Flap 2 is 196 with 1* at 205; 3 is 186; FULL 180.

groups.name: Weights 526.7 / 524.7 / 401.2 / 374.7
groups.hook: Taxi minus 2 = takeoff. Landing 401.2. MZFW 374.7 (starred, see FCOM-LIM-AG-WGHT for tail variants).

groups.name: EGT ladder 920 / 900 / 850 / 700 / 850
groups.hook: 920 for 20 s, 900 for 5 min (10 with engine failure), MCT 850, ground start 700, air start 850.

groups.name: Fuel and FLEX temperatures
groups.hook: Fuel max +55 C, inner tank min -44/-54 C, FLEX max ISA+60 C, FLEX min flat rating or OAT, no FLEX on contaminated. Brakes 300 C for takeoff.

groups.name: Clock: 15 hr / 60 min / 5 min / 30 min / 6.2 hr
groups.hook: APU low oil 15 hr; 3 APU starts then 60 min; starter 5 min continuous; 30 min cooling after 5 min or three cycles; IRS-only RNP-10 6.2 hr.

groups.name: Pressures 9.25 / -0.73 / 8.85 to -0.26 / 3000 +/- 200 / 1000
groups.hook: Cabin max +9.25, min -0.73, safety valve 8.85 to -0.26; hydraulics 3000 +/- 200; oxygen 1000 psi for 2 crew + 2 OBS at 50 C.

groups.name: Prohibited / not permitted / do not
groups.hook: Reverse in flight, backing with reverse, braked pivot turns, APU bleed for wing anti-ice, FLEX on contaminated, LP ground unit = no packs, HP ground unit = no APU bleed, imbalance only exceeded in exceptional conditions.

groups.name: Small ground numbers 70 / 7 / 3 / 72 / 10% / 30% / 2%
groups.hook: Max reverse not below 70 kt; deflated tires 7 kt one, 3 kt two; NWS 72; no running starter engagement above 10% N3 ground / 30% air; runway slope +/- 2%.

groups.name: Quantities 15 qts / 11,461 lbs / 3,261 lbs / Category C / 192 / 198 / 144
groups.hook: Oil 15 qts (6 + est. consumption); min takeoff fuel 11,461; smallest outer-tank imbalance 3,261; approach category C; length 192, span 198, 180-degree turn 144.

extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Length [DSC-20-20] 192'
HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Wingspan [DSC-20-20] 198'

extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Minimum turning width for 180-degree turn [DSC-20-30] 144'
HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Speedbrakes: no limitation

extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Safety relief valve setting 8.85 psi to -0.26 psi
HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): HAL A330 Aircraft Approach Category [FOM 4.3] Category C

extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Max. fuel imbalance limits may be exceeded when in "exceptional conditions"
HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Hydraulics normal operating pressure 3000 psi, +/- 200 psi
HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Nosewheel steering angle limit 72 degrees

extra.q: APU LOW OIL LEVEL ECAM advisory: how long may the APU still be started/operated?
extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): LOW OIL LEVEL ECAM advisory: may start/operate for 15 hrs

extra.q: APU maximum altitude for start and operation?
extra.src: HAL A330 Limitations Summary Rev 0 (10FEB2024): Max. altitude for start and operation 41,450' (aircraft ceiling)
